description: Role changes are not retroactive: policy.json holds today's roles (Lin promoted to product manager and Zhou moved to advisor on 2026-10-10, per the dated announcement), but each act should be judged by the role held when it took effect.

c02.note: Zhou was product manager on 2026-10-03; the later move to advisor does not undo that approval

c04.note: Lin was an engineer on 2026-10-05; the later promotion does not make that approval authorized

Audit log export.note: Approved by Zhou while Zhou was product manager.

Bulk delete.note: Lin's pre-promotion approve is ignored; Ana (product manager throughout) rejects.

Webhooks.note: After 2026-10-10 Zhou is an advisor (ignored) and Lin is product manager (applies): both readings agree.

Exports team.note: The announcement is a comment: announcing a role change in the log grants nothing.

findings.note: only the post-change approve of Webhooks was outside Zhou's role
Lin's approve of Bulk delete came before the promotion
